name: structifact-validate
description: Run Structifact's own `validate` command against the active file and show the results as VS Code diagnostics.

structifact.cliPath.description: Path to the Structifact CLI executable (the `structifact` console script installed by `pip install -e .`). Change this if it isn't on your PATH — e.g. the absolute path to a project virtualenv's bin/structifact.
